verdict.rationale: Veriff is an identity-verification SaaS with a Customer Portal, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents only the API, SDKs, webhooks, manual portal review, and a Zapier no-code integration. Nothing shows a built-in AI assistant users can delegate tasks to; llms.txt and the Zapier automation are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
